title: CG+CS 귀환 RF 로딩과 반송 부호

numeric_independent.method: Independent pure-Python nodal KCL+VCCS Gaussian elimination solver + closed-form analytical CG+CS TIA equations (without importing mna.js or lab.js solver)

verified_flows: predict card answer feedback and dismiss without locking controls
direct click on SVG [data-elem='rf-out'] triggering 20.0% breakdown badge and updating tiles/plot
keyboard Space toggle on [data-elem='rf-in'] and RF log-slider sweep from 1 kΩ (230.0% error) to 100 kΩ (2.1% error)
mode switch to '반송 부호 K', 3-beat +ΔV1 causal domino, and preset verification (K=-0.100 mS, IF=-0.100 mA, 1+KR0=9.25)
mobile 375px right drawer open and Escape close
visual inspection of desktop light/dark and mobile dark screenshots

fixes_during_validation: Moved VDD/VDD (AC 접지) labels up and shifted VDD bars down to y=48 (then compact y=38 with viewBox 700x302) to keep >= 18 units clearance above vertical wires (0 label_gaps).
Wrapped multi-step equations inside KaTeX aligned blocks so span.katex-display fits within .formula-box at both 1440px and 375px with zero overflow.
Compacted loading SVG to viewBox='0 0 700 302' with max-height:216px so .lab-stage never overhangs .predict-card or .plot-wrap vertically on 1440x900.
Fixed KaTeX formatting in diagnosis messages (fmtKOhmTex, missing $...$ in feedthrough warning, distinct message when both replicas are off within 10%) and used fmtSignedMaTex for upright mA units.
